verdicts.reason: A: the photo is cropped to just the mouth and cheek, so the person reads as a meaningless fragment. The headline is small and squeezed into a stacked block with tiny subtitle text, and the bulb and question-mark doodles crowd against it while the right two-thirds of the banner is almost empty. B: it has the same mouth-only crop, and the bulb, question-mark and atom doodles are piled directly on the face, an unintended-looking collision. Still, its headline is much larger and reads clearly left to right, with the subtitle and molecule spread across the width, so its hierarchy and fit to the banner shape are better.
